title: May the same item be used again?
hook: May the same item be used again? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
DP reachability; a bitmask names a subset; base-10 digits.
doesNotKnow: Use an ascending capacity loop for reusable items and distinguish it from 0-1 updates.

misconception: Changing iteration direction never changes which item combinations a DP permits.
objective: Use an ascending capacity loop for reusable items and distinguish it from 0-1 updates.

claims.text: Ascending capacities can read a state already updated by the same item. The witnessed optimum therefore permits repeated copies; descending capacities preserve single-use choices.
